extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/practitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; disciplinary counsel and Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: A formal decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under the disciplinary rules (37 C.F.R. § 11.58), documenting receipt, supporting affidavit, review, and the Director's determination to grant reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: The petitioner must file an affidavit in support of the Petition for Reinstatement pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 (as modified by any applicable Final Order).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document notes an affidavit was filed in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 and the October 2, 2018 Final Order in the related disciplinary proceeding. The affidavit and petition are the primary materials reviewed in considering reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review and determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline reviews the petition and supporting affidavit and determines whether reinstatement to practice before the USPTO is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After careful review of the Petition and supporting Affidavit the Director may grant reinstatement; the decision here states the Petition was received on January 16, 2019, was reviewed, and reinstatement was granted. No additional factual findings or criteria are stated on the page itself.
